english.summary: A virtual reality application for physiotherapy students to study the human spine.
english.description: A virtual reality application created for physiotherapy students to explore and study the human spine in an immersive environment. It was developed as a Computer Engineering final project at the University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, in collaboration with the School of Physiotherapy.
english.role: Solo developer · Computer Engineering final project
english.award: Runner-up Award from the Telefónica Chair for Educational Innovation
